name: Month Wise Sales
query:
SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_list.date)::integer AS "YEAR",
    TO_CHAR(date_list.date, 'FMMonth') AS "MONTH",
    ROUND(SUM(b."net_total"), 2) AS "Item Total",
    ROUND(SUM(b."total_taxes_and_charges"), 2) AS "Total Taxes and Charges",
    ROUND(SUM(b."grand_total"), 2) AS "Grand Total"
FROM generate_series(
    date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '4 months',
    CURRENT_DATE,
    interval '1 day'
) AS date_list(date)
LEFT JOIN "tabPOS Invoice" b ON (
    b."branch" = %(branch)s
    AND b."status" IN ('Consolidated', 'Paid')
    AND b."docstatus" = 1
)
LEFT JOIN "tabURY Report Settings" rs ON (rs."branch" = %(branch)s)
WHERE (
    ((rs."hours" IS NULL OR rs."hours" = 0) AND b."posting_date" = date_list.date)
    OR (
        rs."hours" > 0
        AND (b."posting_date" + b."posting_time") >=
            (date_list.date + make_interval(hours => rs."hours"::integer))
        AND (b."posting_date" + b."posting_time") <
            (date_list.date + interval '1 day' + make_interval(hours => rs."hours"::integer))
    )
    OR (rs."branch" IS NULL AND b."posting_date" = date_list.date)
)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_list.date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_list.date), TO_CHAR(date_list.date, 'FMMonth')
ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_list.date) DESC, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_list.date) DESC
